1: // Simple Lava Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" assumed in HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Game state
11:   const player = { x: width / 2, y: height - 30, w: 20, h: 20, speed: 4 };
12:   let lavaY = height; // starts off-screen bottom
13:   let lavaSpeed = 0.3;
14:   let air = 10; // seconds of air
15:   const bubbles = [];
16:   let lastBubble = 0;
17: 
18:   // Input handling
19:   const keys = {};
20:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
21:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
22: 
23:   function spawnBubble() {
24:     const radius = 8;
25:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
26:     const y = Math.random() * (lavaY - 100) + 50; // stay above lava
27:     bubbles.push({ x, y, radius, collected: false });
28:   }
29: 
30:   function update(dt) {
31:     // Player movement
32:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
33:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
34:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.w, player.x));
35: 
36:     // Lava rise
37:     lavaY -= lavaSpeed * dt;
38:     lavaSpeed += 0.00002 * dt; // accelerate
39: 
40:     // Air consumption
41:     air -= dt / 1000;
42: 
43:     // Bubble spawning
44:     if (performance.now() - lastBubble > 2000) {
45:       spawnBubble();
46:       lastBubble = performance.now();
47:     }
48:     // Check bubble collection
49:     for (const b of bubbles) {
50:       if (!b.collected) {
51:         const dx = b.x - (player.x + player.w / 2);
52:         const dy = b.y - (player.y + player.h / 2);
53:         const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
54:         if (dist < b.radius + Math.max(player.w, player.h) / 2) {
55:           b.collected = true;
56:           air += 3; // add 3 seconds
57:         }
58:       }
59:     }
60:   }
61: 
62:   function draw() {
63:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
64:     // Lava
65:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orangered';
66:     ctx.fillRect(0, lavaY, width, height - lavaY);
67:     // Player
68:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
69:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
70:     // Bubbles
71:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lightblue';
72:     for (const b of bubbles) {
73:       if (!b.collected) {
74:         ctx.beginPath();
75:         ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
76:         ctx.fill();
77:       }
78:     }
79:     // HUD
80:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
81:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
82:     ctx.fillText(`Air: ${air.toFixed(1)}s`, 10, 20);
83:   }
84: 
85:   let last = performance.now();
86:   function loop() {
87:     const now = performance.now();
88:     const dt = now - last;
89:     last = now;
90:     update(dt);
91:     draw();
92:     // Lose condition
93:     if (air <= 0 || lavaY <= player.y + player.h) {
94:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
95:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
96:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
97:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
98:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
99:     } else {
100:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
101:     }
102:   }
103:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
104: })();
